purpose: Enterprise loose-ends captured after Track 1 (Admin, Compliance, Approvals) shipped. Ranked by what would actually block a real customer POC, not by what's easy to build.

P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.title: Postgres migration
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.problem: SQLite in prod — single file, no HA, no replication, sensitive to concurrent writes.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.impact: Lose the disk, lose everything. Won't clear a security review at a bank.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.next_step: Add a Postgres URL to config, run the existing Alembic migrations against a Postgres instance, verify test_phase0 still passes end-to-end.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.rough_effort: 3-5 days including a real backup story

P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.title: CI on GitHub Actions
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.problem: No .github/workflows/. The 282 tests only run when someone remembers.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.impact: A regression can land on master unnoticed.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.next_step: One workflow: pytest (backend), tsc + next build (frontend), on every PR + push to master.

P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.title: CORS middleware on FastAPI
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.problem: No CORSMiddleware. Works today only because of the Next.js proxy rewrite.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.impact: Split frontend origin -> browsers block everything. Blocks partner integrations.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.next_step: Add starlette.middleware.cors.CORSMiddleware with an explicit allow_origins list from config.

P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.title: Rate limiting
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.impact: Password brute force, activation-token spraying, DoS on the expensive planner.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.next_step: slowapi with an IP-based limit on /auth/token + /activate; a per-user quota on /deals/check + /planner + /advisory.

P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.title: SSO / MFA
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.impact: Enterprise buyers ask on the first call; won't clear a bank security review.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.next_step: OIDC via a hosted IdP (Auth0 / Azure AD / Entra) — TR keeps role mapping; IdP owns credentials.

P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.title: Secrets management
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.problem: Groq API key + DB paths live in VM env vars.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.impact: Rotation is manual. Audit trail on secret access = 0.
P0_blockers_for_a_customer_sale.next_step: Azure Key Vault (matches the VM host) with SDK integration on start-up.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: Policy editor + four-eye write enforcement
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: policy_version has changed_by / authorised_by columns (ADR-0017) but no write surface; they stay null forever.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.impact: Policy history tab reads 'not recorded' for authoriser on every row today.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: Admin page 'Policy' section that writes a new policy_version behind an access_change_request (ADR-0015 pattern), enforcing requester != authoriser.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: AI activity log — closes Q-004
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: No ai_run table. Can't answer 'what did the model say on 3 Aug and did the user accept?'
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: ai_run table (prompt, response, model, tokens, endpoint, subject_id, outcome). Compliance tab reads it.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: Override reason quality
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: A signer can override with 'yes'. No min length, no reason code.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: Pydantic validator: min 20 chars + a reason_code from a small catalogue.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: deals_missing_evidence KPI pollution
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: Overview permanently shows 4 because seed plants historical deals bypassing the engine.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: Either backfill check_run rows on seed, or scope the KPI to deals with trade_date >= policy_version.effective_from of the earliest recorded policy.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: audit_event retention + index
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: Unbounded growth; only actor + subject indexes exist. No (tenant_id, occurred_at) index.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: Add composite index; add a nightly archive job for events > 7y (regulator floor). Retention policy noted in an ADR.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: Point-in-time replay
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: check_run captures the policy + limit version, but limits/exposures elsewhere don't snapshot 'as-of'.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.impact: Auditor asks 'what did we see on 12 May?' — only part-answer available.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: Extend cp_limit + currency_exposure with an 'as_of' snapshot table; state_service accepts as_of_date.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: Activation token rate limit + lockout
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: No cap on POST /activate; no failure lock-out. Noted as prototype in ADR-0014.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: Bucket per token id + per source IP; lock after N invalid attempts.

P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.title: Override in breaches: authoriser distinct from proposer
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.problem: In the breaches feed, actor_display == authoriser_display for overrides. Doesn't prove two hands.
P1_compliance_integrity_gaps.next_step: Deal.record now captures proposer; the override signer signs later. Store both on the audit_event payload or read Deal.approved_by and split the columns.

P2_product_persona_gaps.title: Approvals: reject with reason
P2_product_persona_gaps.problem: One-click Approve only; no reject flow.
P2_product_persona_gaps.next_step: Reject modal with a reason (min-len enforced), audit event action='deal.rejected'.

P2_product_persona_gaps.title: Approvals: bulk + delegation
P2_product_persona_gaps.problem: No out-of-office reassignment; no multi-select approve.
P2_product_persona_gaps.next_step: Small delegation table (user -> deputy, effective_from, effective_to); batch approve endpoint.

P2_product_persona_gaps.title: SMTP delivery — closes Q-001
P2_product_persona_gaps.problem: Invite / breach / approval-request emails are console-only.
P2_product_persona_gaps.next_step: SES or Azure Communication Services adapter behind a MailProvider port; retry with dead-letter.

P2_product_persona_gaps.title: Access-change queue notifications
P2_product_persona_gaps.problem: Second admin has to notice on their own. The four-eye control works but has zero cadence.
P2_product_persona_gaps.next_step: On create_role_grant_request, email every user with MANAGE_USERS except the requester.

P2_product_persona_gaps.title: Admin: recent activity widget
P2_product_persona_gaps.problem: Compliance has one, Admin doesn't — an admin needs to know 'what happened in my persona in the last 24h?'
P2_product_persona_gaps.next_step: Small tile on /admin sourced from audit_event action LIKE 'user.%' OR 'access_change.%'.

P3_operational.title: Frontend not built for production
P3_operational.problem: VM runs 'npm run dev'; source maps + Turbopack are shipping to users.
P3_operational.next_step: next build && next start behind Caddy; NSSM service definition swap.

P3_operational.title: Error tracking + structured logs + metrics
P3_operational.problem: No Sentry, no metrics, no structured logs. /health exists; nothing else.
P3_operational.next_step: Sentry SDK + structlog + Prometheus /metrics behind admin auth. One dashboard: response time, 5xx rate, deal write rate, audit events/hour.

P3_operational.title: Backup + snapshot
P3_operational.problem: SQLite file has no snapshot rotation. Ties into P0-01 (Postgres).

P3_operational.title: Dependency scanning
P3_operational.problem: No Dependabot, no SCA — you inherit every upstream CVE.
P3_operational.next_step: Enable Dependabot; add pip-audit + npm audit to the CI workflow (P0-02).

P3_operational.title: Frontend tests
P3_operational.problem: All 282 tests are backend Python. Every .tsx ships untested.
P3_operational.next_step: Vitest for component logic, Playwright for one golden e2e (propose -> approve -> compliance -> evidence).

P4_product_polish.title: override_reason on hedges
P4_product_polish.problem: Only deals capture override_reason today. Hedge audit event carries no equivalent when the six checks fail.

P4_product_polish.title: Approval queue: age column
P4_product_polish.problem: No 'how long has this been sitting' — SLA blind.

P4_product_polish.title: Print stylesheet on Deal evidence
P4_product_polish.problem: Copy evidence pack is plain text; a print/PDF view would be nicer for a workpaper.

P4_product_polish.title: Timezone selector
P4_product_polish.problem: Every timestamp is browser-local; a global team disagrees.
P4_product_polish.next_step: User profile timezone; server sends UTC; frontend formats with a persisted preference.

P4_product_polish.title: Compliance tab consistency in treasurer page
P4_product_polish.problem: Compliance has a tabbed shell; the operational treasurer page doesn't. Inconsistent UX.

still_open_questions_this_roadmap_does_n: Q-002 tenancy model when we go multi-tenant — shared schema vs schema-per-tenant
